title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass; Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell; Resampled from 96 to 44.1 khz in r8brain Pro > dithered in Izotope Ozone 3 (MBIT+, high noise shaping, 16 bit depth, normal dither, DC offset filter on) > exported to 16 bit in Audacity 2.0.0 > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Great‑sounding recording captures a stellar May 1970 show highlighted by an epic The Other One and scorching Cosmic Charlie
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance, singling out a ferocious The Other One, a blistering Cosmic Charlie, and tight renditions of Candyman, Cumberland Blues and Deep River Blues.  The recording is described as clear and enjoyable, though several reviewers note that only part of the concert is available.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive comments about both musical performance and sound quality; only minor criticism about incompleteness, yielding an exceptional‑plus rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call the audio "great sounding" and "fine recording", with no specific complaints about clarity or balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Listeners appreciate the seamless flow from acoustic material into a high‑energy electric set, noting long uninterrupted jams (e.g., Candyman into Cumberland and a half‑hour The Other One).

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar work is repeatedly praised, especially his melodic passages in The Other One.
